string.text: Find the Expert Toolkit
With this toolkit, Thunderov will have enough tools to do virtually any upgrades for weapons and armor.
Find the Flash Drive: SVU
With this Flash Drive, Thunderov will have information on how to modify a SVU sniper rifle.
Find the Flash Drive: RP-74
With this Flash Drive, Thunderov will have information on how to modify a medium machine gun.
Find the Flash Drive: VAL
With this Flash Drive, Thunderov will have information on how to adjust the internal mechanics of any subsonic rifle correctly.
Find the Flash Drive: Tunder Barrel
With this Flash Drive, Thunderov will have information on how to adjust the barrel and intergrated grenade launcher of the Tunder assault rifle to take a silencer.

Deliver a Chimera claw
Duty is looking to see how the Chimera can cut through armour so effectively, and requires a claw to examine.
Deliver a Bloodsucker's tentacles
Duty is looking for the tentacles of a Bloodsucker so they can study the saliva it produces, and find a means to stop the bleeding from wounds caused by the Bloodsucker.
Deliver a Bubble artifact
Duty is looking to try and manufacture an alternate antiradtion medicine, and they need a Bubble artifact to help them in their studies.
Deliver a Eye artifact
Krylov wants a Eye artifact to bring him good luck. He probably wants it to provide him with good luck in their fight against the Zone and Freedom.
Deliver a Flash artifact
Duty is conducting research into anomalies, and needs a Flash artifact to assist them in several tests.
Deliver a SVD sniper rifle
Duty is looking to outfit some of its sniper with SVD rifles, and has requested one for testing.
Deliver a RPG-7 rocket launcher
A Duty squad recently had one of their rocket launchers destroyed somehow in a firefight with Bandits, and have requested a new one.
